description: Typhoeus's team with Arcane in INT mode (her Hot Work loadout: examples/variants/typhoeus-arcane-int.scenario.json), found by efsim rules --guided (2026-11-22, 4 rounds, the objective across starts) from the team's WILL-mode list: Arcane's battle skill also before Perlica's combo, and Typhoeus takes flight only once the enemy's Stagger bar is at least 70% full. On 32 fresh seeds (1001–1032, 300 s, 0.3 s reaction), against the WILL list on the same INT gear: +1.97% ± 0.81 (full energy 55,004 → 56,628, from zero 53,227 → 53,730). Against the WILL team with its own list (examples/typhoeus-arcane-liino-perlica.*), rules against rules on 64 fresh seeds (1001–1064) and the objective across starts: −1.91% ± 0.60 (docs/teams/typhoeus-arcane-liino-perlica.md "Gear played by the rules").
